description: Belgian road network - Top10Vector is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by NGI - IGN. Top10Vector - Road network is the vector data set of the Belgian road network. It contains five classes. First class: dirt roads. Second class: kilometer markers along the road network. Third class: path segments. Fourth class: road obstructions. Fifth class: road segments. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in MSG_HTTP. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-05-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-nc. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
